files.description: Playwright tests for the labels feature: Settings vocabulary filtering and CRUD, duplicate validation, enable/disable persistence, classify-labels system automation configuration, re-classify backfill enqueue, photo detail label rendering, and gallery label filter UI state.

testContext: Labels are split across Settings (#labels-section), gallery filters (#filter-form plus a hidden #labels-match-type radio group), media details (.detail-section containing Labels/Label header), and the system automation at /utilities/automations/classify_labels. The Settings labels panel is HTMX-driven: create/delete swap #labels-section, toggle returns 204 with no swap, duplicate validation returns a notification toast and preserves typed form values, and reclassify returns a toast with no swap. The classify-labels automation is a system automation: no edit/delete buttons, configurable via #configureAutomationModal fields #config-confidence_threshold and #config-max_labels, and run history is in #automation-runs. CLIP output can vary by environment, so detail/filter tests assert robust label UI contracts and tolerate no-label states rather than assuming specific classifications.
explanation: Generated manually from specs/labels.yaml after inspecting templates/settings/_labels.html, static/settings/labels.js, routes/settings.py, templates/filters/_labels.html, templates/media/view.html, templates/utilities/automations.html, routes/utilities/automations.py, and background_tasks/automation_config.py. Tests run serially because they mutate shared label vocabulary and automation config. The spec typechecks with the yaffo_ui_tests TypeScript config; Playwright runtime was not executed here because the isolated Flask app/task worker was not started in this turn.
